name: Brassy Bass
description: Two saws whose filter opens with a short swell at each note and stays half open: a bass with the push of a horn section.

name: Deep Pulse Bass
description: A square with B's triangle an octave under it, the filter low and barely moved: a deep, steady bass that is mostly felt.

name: Detuned Bass
description: Two saws a quarter tone apart beat against each other under a warm filter: a thick, moving bass.

name: Fifth Bass
description: A saw with B a fifth above it, the filter half shut: a power bass that sounds a chord in every note.

name: Funk Bass
description: Two saws through a resonant filter the envelope sweeps down at each note: a quacking bass that bounces.

name: Growl Bass
description: Oscillator B a fifth up and quiet, its ramp shaking the filter at audio rate through Poly-Mod: a bass with a growl in it that the envelope opens.

name: Hum Bass
description: B's triangle alone, A silent, under a closed filter: a smooth sub that holds the floor.

name: Nasal Bass
description: A narrow pulse, B's narrow pulse an octave down, the filter half open: a reedy bass that cuts through.

name: Picked Bass
description: A saw and a pulse that die away within a beat, the filter snapped open and shut: a picked bass for busy lines.

name: Pulse Width Bass
description: A pulse whose width the LFO swings through Wheel-Mod, with B's saw an octave under it: a bass that churns as it holds.

name: Rubber Bass
description: A saw and a pulse an octave down into a resonant filter that the envelope snaps open at each note and lets fall back: a round, elastic bass.

name: Saw Punch Bass
description: Two saws, B an octave down, the filter flicked open at each note and settling low: a plain, punchy saw bass that sits under anything.

name: Slide Bass
description: The voices in unison, scarcely spread, gliding from note to note through a filter with some bite: a bass that slides where the notes touch.

name: Square Bass
description: Two squares, B an octave down, through a filter that the envelope opens a little: a hollow, woody square bass.

name: Squeal Bass
description: One saw into a filter near singing, the envelope sweeping it down fast, the voices in unison and gliding: a squealing bass for acid lines.

name: Stack Bass
description: All five voices on the one key, spread by the detune, two saws each: a wide, heavy bass for a single line.

name: Sync Bass
description: A synced to B, tuned up a seventh so it tears, the filter envelope pushing A's pitch through Poly-Mod at each note: a hard, talking bass.

name: Thump Bass
description: A saw an octave down, the filter all but shut and flicked open for a moment, the amplifier gone in a beat: a short, dark thump.

name: Wobble Bass
description: The LFO's triangle sweeps the resonant filter through Wheel-Mod, a few times a beat: a bass that wobbles.

name: Wooden Bass
description: A narrow pulse and B's triangle low through a dark filter, fading as a plucked string does: a soft, woody bass.

name: Zap Bass
description: The filter envelope throws A's pitch up through Poly-Mod for an instant at each note: a bass with a zap at its start. The envelope falls to nothing, so A comes back to the key while the note is held.

name: Brass Stack
description: Two saws a few cents apart behind a filter that the envelope opens with a short swell and lets settle half shut: a section of horns.

name: Brass Swell
description: The filter and the amplifier both swell in over half a second: horns that crescendo into each chord.

name: Bright Brass
description: Saws whose filter jumps wide open at each chord and settles bright: punchy horns that cut.

name: Fanfare Brass
description: Saws with B a fifth up, the filter opening quickly: open, ringing chords for fanfares.

name: Horn Section
description: A pulse and a saw detuned, a soft swell and a slow vibrato on the wheel: a section of French horns.

name: Low Brass
description: Saws an octave apart under a darker filter that swells: trombones and tubas.

name: Short Brass
description: Saws whose filter opens and closes inside a beat, the amplifier falling too: short, stabbed horns.

name: Soft Brass
description: Two saws whose filter opens slowly and not far: mellow horns for held chords.

name: Sync Brass
description: A synced to B and pulled up by the filter envelope through Poly-Mod as the horns swell: brass with a tearing edge.

name: Dark Stab
description: Saws under a low, resonant filter that the envelope flicks: a dark, round stab for deep house chords.

name: Detuned Stab
description: Two saws a quarter tone apart, short and bright: a stab that beats and spreads.

name: Fifth Stab
description: A saw with B a fifth up, so every chord doubles in fifths, short and bright: a stab for rave chords.

name: Organ Stab
description: Squares an octave apart with a quick fade, the filter bright: a short organ chord for dance tracks.

name: Poly Stab
description: Two saws, the filter opened hard and shut within a beat: the bright chord stab.

name: Sync Stab
description: A synced to B and swept down by the filter envelope through Poly-Mod at each chord: a hard, tearing stab.

name: Wah Chords
description: Oscillator B at low frequency, its ramp sweeping each voice's resonant filter through Poly-Mod, every voice at its own pace: chords that wah.

name: Bubbles
description: The LFO's square and saw together jump the resonant filter through Wheel-Mod several times a second: bubbling water.

name: Clang Hit
description: B a tritone up, out of tune, swinging A's pitch hard at audio rate through Poly-Mod, struck and ringing out: a metal hit.

name: Drift Drone
description: The five voices in unison, spread wide, B at low frequency rocking A's pitch a little through Poly-Mod: a slowly beating, uneasy drone.

name: Laser Zap
description: The filter envelope throws A's pitch three octaves up through Poly-Mod and lets it fall in a moment: a ray gun.

name: Resonant Sweep
description: Two saws into the filter just under singing, the envelope sweeping its corner up through the harmonics over two seconds and slowly back down.

name: Riser
description: Saws and noise whose filter and pitch climb over several seconds, A pulled up by the slow filter envelope through Poly-Mod: a build-up for a drop.

name: Robot Voice
description: B a little under A, its ramp beating against the resonant filter through Poly-Mod: a buzzing, talking machine.

name: Siren Drift
description: Oscillator B at low frequency swings A's pitch up and down through Poly-Mod, each voice at its own pace: a slow siren that drifts apart in chords.

name: Thunder
description: Noise and a low saw through a closed filter that the envelope opens and lets roll away over seconds: a distant rumble.

name: Wind
description: Noise alone through a filter near singing, the slow LFO sweeping it through Wheel-Mod: wind that gusts and whistles.

name: Felt Keys
description: Two triangles' worth of tone, B's triangle under a quiet saw, the filter dark: a soft, felted keyboard for chords.

name: Glass Bells
description: Oscillator B's triangle, an octave and a half up and silent in the mix, swings A's pitch at audio rate through Poly-Mod: clangorous partials over a soft strike, ringing out and fading at each key.

name: Mallet Keys
description: B's triangle two octaves up, quietly shaking A's pitch through Poly-Mod as the strike dies away, the slow LFO wavering the pitch: struck metal bars.

name: Plectrum Keys
description: Narrow pulses an octave apart, bright and quick to fade, the release short: keys plucked like a harpsichord's.

name: Pulse Clav
description: Two narrow pulses, B an octave up, through a filter that snaps shut: a nasal, percussive clav for rhythm parts.

name: Soft Piano
description: A saw and B's triangle, the filter opened by the strike and closing as the note fades: a soft, dark electric piano.

name: Square Organ
description: Two squares an octave apart, the envelopes square on and off: a plain organ that starts and stops with the keys.

name: Thumb Keys
description: A's pitch dropping a little into the note through Poly-Mod, a round tone that fades fast: a thumb piano.

name: Tine Keys
description: B an octave up modulates A's pitch through Poly-Mod for a bell-like edge, and the filter envelope closes over it: a bright strike that settles to a round tone, like an electric piano's tine.

name: Toy Piano
description: B two octaves up, ringing through Poly-Mod with a quick fade: a small, tinny piano.

name: Wah Clav
description: A narrow pulse and a saw through a resonant filter that the envelope throws open: a clav through a wah.

name: Wood Mallets
description: B's triangle with A's pulse quiet, a fast strike that falls away within a beat: wooden bars, like a marimba.

name: Airy Lead
description: A saw and a good share of noise through a filter that follows the keys: a breathy lead with air round the note.

name: Brass Lead
description: Two saws whose filter swells open at each note and holds, A's pitch nudged by the envelope through Poly-Mod: a lead that speaks like a trumpet.

name: Breath Lead
description: B's triangle alone with a breath of noise, a short swell and a slow vibrato on the wheel: a soft lead like a flute.

name: Fat Lead
description: The voices in unison and spread wide, two saws each a fifth apart: a huge, detuned lead.

name: Fifth Lead
description: A saw with B a fifth above, the filter opened by the envelope at each note: a bright lead that plays in fifths.

name: Hollow Lead
description: A narrow pulse with B's narrow pulse a little sharp, the filter open: a thin, nasal lead like a reed.

name: Low Saw Lead
description: Two saws with B an octave down under a warm, resonant filter: a round lead for low melodies.

name: Metal Lead
description: B nineteen semitones up and silent, its ramp swinging A's pitch at audio rate through Poly-Mod: a hard, metallic lead with bell partials.

name: Octave Lead
description: A saw with B an octave up, both bright, the voices in unison and a short glide: a lead that cuts through a mix.

name: Portamento Lead
description: The voices in unison, slightly spread, with a long glide, so every interval slides: a lead for slow melodies.

name: Singing Lead
description: One saw into a filter well into its resonance, following the keys, its corner over the note: a lead that sings with a nasal ring.

name: Soft Saw Lead
description: Two saws a little apart through a filter that sits just over the melody, a touch of glide: a mellow lead that sings without biting.

name: Square Lead
description: Two squares, B an octave up and quieter, the filter half open: a hollow, reedy lead.

name: Sync Pulse Lead
description: A's pulse synced to B, the wheel's LFO sweeping A's pitch slowly so the sync partial moves as a note holds: a lead that changes color on long notes.

name: Sync Scream
description: The voices in unison, A synced to B and swept a long way up by the filter envelope through Poly-Mod, slow to fall: a screaming sync lead.

name: Sync Sweep
description: Oscillator A synced to B, its pitch thrown up by the filter envelope through Poly-Mod and falling back as the envelope decays, B under it for body: the tearing sync lead the instrument is known for.

name: Thin Sync Lead
description: A synced to B an octave and a half up with B silent, a fixed, bright overtone and no sweep: a glassy, thin sync lead.

name: Unison Lead
description: All five voices stacked on the lowest key held, spread by the detune, two saws each with B an octave down, gliding from note to note: a thick mono lead.

name: Vibrato Lead
description: Two saws with the LFO's triangle on both pitches through Wheel-Mod, the wheel a little up: a singing lead with its vibrato built in.

name: Wah Lead
description: Two saws through a resonant filter that the envelope throws open and lets fall back at each note: a lead that says wah.

name: Whistle Lead
description: B's triangle an octave up through a filter that rounds it nearly to a sine, gliding between notes: a pure, whistled line.

name: Breath Pad
description: Saws behind a large share of noise, the filter low and resonant: a pad that is half breath.

name: Bright Pad
description: Two saws wide apart through an open filter: a bright, beating pad that sits on top.

name: Dark Pad
description: Two saws, B an octave down, under a nearly closed filter: a dark bed that fills the low middle.

name: Dusk Pad
description: A saw over B's triangle an octave down, a breath of noise, through a warm, slightly resonant filter that opens slowly and stays: a pad for long chords.

name: Fifth Pad
description: A saw with B's triangle a fifth up, so every note is an open fifth: a wide, open pad.

name: Glass Pad
description: B an octave and a fifth up, quiet, swinging A's pitch a little at audio rate through Poly-Mod: a pad with a glassy edge over its chord.

name: Hollow Pad
description: Two squares an octave apart under a soft filter: a hollow, organ-like pad.

name: Pulse Pad
description: Two pulses whose widths the slow LFO swings through Wheel-Mod: a pad that moves and shimmers as it holds.

name: Sweep Pad
description: Two saws into a resonant filter that the envelope opens over a few seconds and closes as slowly: a pad that rises through its chord.

name: Sync Pad
description: A synced to B, the slow filter envelope pulling A's pitch through Poly-Mod as the chord swells: a pad whose color shifts as it opens.

name: Tide Pad
description: The slow LFO's triangle sweeps the resonant filter through Wheel-Mod, each chord rising and falling like a tide.

name: Vowel Pad
description: Two saws through a resonant filter that does not follow the keys, so each chord passes through the same ringing band: a pad that sounds like a held vowel.

name: Warm Pad
description: Two saws a few cents apart under a low filter, a soft swell and a long release: the plain, warm pad.

name: Bent Pluck
description: The filter envelope bends A's pitch down onto the note through Poly-Mod at each strike: a pluck that twangs.

name: Bright Pluck
description: Two saws apart, the filter thrown wide open and closed in a moment: a bright, snappy pluck.

name: Glass Pluck
description: B an octave and a fifth up, swinging A's pitch at audio rate through Poly-Mod while the strike dies: a glassy, bell-tinged pluck.

name: Harp Pluck
description: B's triangle and a quiet saw, a soft strike and a long ring: a harp's string.

name: Muted Pluck
description: A pulse under a nearly closed filter, its strike short: a muted, palm-damped pluck.

name: Nylon Pluck
description: A narrowish pulse and a saw an octave up through a filter that the envelope flicks open and lets fall to nothing: a short, bright pluck for arpeggios.

name: Resonant Pluck
description: One saw through a resonant filter that the envelope sweeps down fast: a pluck that chirps.

name: Blip Sequence
description: B's triangle an octave up, short as a click: little blips for fast arpeggios.

name: Muted Sequence
description: Two saws under a closed filter, flicked a little at each step: a dark, muted pulse under a track.

name: Pulse Sequence
description: A narrow pulse whose filter clicks open at each note and closes before the next: tight sixteenths.

name: Resonant Sequence
description: One saw into a filter near singing, the envelope flicking it at each step: a squelching sequence.

name: Saw Sequence
description: Two saws, B an octave down, the filter snapping at each step: a bright, driving sequence.

name: Sync Sequence
description: A synced to B, the envelope thrusting A's pitch through Poly-Mod at each step: a sequence that zaps.

name: Bright Strings
description: Saws through an open filter, quick to speak: a bright section for stabs and runs.

name: Chamber Strings
description: Narrow pulses a little apart, the filter half open: a small, thin string group.

name: Ensemble Strings
description: Two saws detuned wide, a gentle bow and a slow vibrato on the wheel: a full string ensemble.

name: Low Strings
description: A saw and a pulse an octave down, darker and slower: the cellos and basses of the section.

name: Plucked Strings
description: Two saws that die within a beat, the filter snapped shut: strings plucked rather than bowed.

name: Slow Strings
description: Saws under a darker filter, a long bow in and a long release: strings for slow passages.

name: Wide Strings
description: A pulse whose width the LFO swings through Wheel-Mod and a saw a little sharp, slow to swell and slow to let go: the instrument's string section.
